title.en: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Baybay, Province of Leyte and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Baybay, Province of Leyte and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy Land Transportation Office tại Thành phố Baybay, Tỉnh Leyte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขตปกติ Land Transportation Office ในเมือง Baybay จังหวัด Leyte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Distrik Reguler Land Transportation Office di Kota Baybay, Provinsi Leyte, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Daerah Biasa Land Transportation Office di Bandar Baybay, Wilayah Leyte, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: A regular district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) is hereby established in the City of Baybay, Province of Leyte.

The Secretary of Transportation and Communications shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the operationalization of the Regular LTO District Office in the City of Baybay, Province of Leyte, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
